title: Soft power of the Gaussian quadrant probability
statement: For every correlation parameter $0<\rho<1$, the Gaussian quadrant probability as a function of its upper-tail parameter has soft power $2/(1+\rho)$ at zero: as $\mu\to0^+$, the ratio of the logarithm of that probability at $\mu$ to $\log\mu$ tends to $2/(1+\rho)$.
